The role will play a key part in maintaining the integrity of treasury data within Kyriba, supporting treasury accounting processes, and ensuring treasury transactions are correctly reflected in financial reporting systems. Beyond supporting day-to-day treasury accounting and controls activities, you will contribute to building and enhancing the treasury operating model, systems landscape, and control framework of ABB Robotics as it transitions into a standalone company. The location of the role is flexible within Europe. The working model is hybrid Your Responsibilities Own Treasury Accounting & Month-End Close: Take ownership of treasury accounting and reporting activities, playing a key role in the month-end close process and ensuring treasury transactions and balances are accurately recorded and reflected in the financial reporting systems. Ensure Accurate Reconciliations & Controls: Review, validate and reconcile treasury-related accounting entries and balances between Kyriba, SAP and other financial systems. Work closely with FAO on pre- and post-closing checks, investigate discrepancies and ensure the accuracy and completeness of treasury records. Manage Treasury Data & Accounting Set-up: Ensure the accuracy and integrity of treasury transaction data and accounting configurations in Kyriba, covering bank accounts, cash pools, short- and long-term loans, FX forwards and swaps, investments and guarantees. Strengthen Processes, Policies & Controls: Maintain and continuously improve treasury accounting processes, models, policies, procedures and controls. Support audit and SOX requirements, identify operational risks and drive improvements to strengthen the treasury control framework. Enable Effective Treasury Systems: Support treasury system enhancements, testing, integrations and implementation activities, acting as a key interface between Treasury, Accounting and IS teams to ensure effective processes, systems and data flows. Drive Automation & Transformation: Contribute to treasury transformation initiatives, including the development of the Treasury Operating Model, process automation and the use of data analytics and AI-enabled solutions to improve treasury processes, controls and reporting. Your Background Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related field; an accounting qualification such as ACCA, CPA, CIMA or equivalent is a strong plus. At least 5 years’ experience in Treasury Accounting, Financial Accounting, Controlling, Treasury Operations or a similar Middle Office function, ideally in a multinational environment. Strong hands-on experience in month-end closing processes, including reviewing and validating accounting entries, performing account reconciliations and investigating discrepancies. Solid knowledge of treasury products and their accounting treatment, particularly short- and long-term loans, FX forwards and FX swaps; exposure to cash pools, investments, guarantees or trade finance is an advantage. Experience working with Treasury Management Systems and ERP systems; Kyriba and SAP experience is considered an advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, and a proactive, collaborative mindset. Interest or experience in process automation, data analytics or AI-enabled solutions is highly valued. Fluent English is required; other languages are a plus. Please submit your application in English. We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

review_candidates.title: Technical Training Specialist
review_candidates.description: Ready to help shape the future of air traffic management in Australia? The Organisation Airservices Australia is a government-owned organisation responsible for the safe and efficient management of 11% of the world's airspace and provision of aviation rescue fire fighting services at Australia's busiest airports. Our people are our greatest asset with a dynamic and diverse team operating from locations across the country, from bustling cities to regional and remote locations. Together, we help secure the future of Australia's skies and keep them amongst the safest in the world. We connect people with their world safely, linking family and friends, generating economic activity, creating jobs, and facilitating trade and tourism. Airservices is committed to fostering a culture that is diverse, inclusive and respectful. We encourage motivated individuals who love what they do, value a service-first mindset and embrace a challenge to explore a career with Airservices. In return, you will be a valued team member, be offered flexibility and experience a meaningful career in an exciting, ever-evolving aviation industry. The Role and the Team The Integrated Air Traffic Management Technology Suite (I-ATS) Program is one of the most significant technology initiatives currently underway within Airservices. The program will replace critical air traffic management technology across Melbourne, Brisbane, Sydney and Perth, helping support the future of aviation in Australia. As the Technical Training Specialist , you will play a critical role in ensuring our workforce is prepared for the successful implementation of this next-generation technology. Working closely with technical experts, operational teams and program stakeholders, you will lead the design, development and implementation of competency-based technical training solutions. You will conduct training needs analyses, develop learning and assessment materials, coordinate training delivery activities and ensure technical training programs meet regulatory and operational requirements. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a national technology transformation program while helping to build the capability required to support the future of air traffic management in Australia. You will be part of a highly skilled and collaborative team focused on delivering safe, effective and compliant training outcomes across a complex operational environment. Airservices is seeking candidates who can commence on, or as close as possible to, 12 October 2026. Given the program delivery timelines, candidates who are immediately available or have short notice periods will be highly regarded. Skills And Experience The successful applicant will have: Minimum five years' recent experience in training delivery within the aviation industry. Demonstrated knowledge and application of Civil Aviation Safety Regulations (CASR), particularly Part 171. Experience developing and delivering competency-based training and assessment solutions. Experience undertaking Training Needs Analyses and developing structured learning programs. Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced project environment with competing priorities. Certificate IV in Training and Assessment or equivalent qualification. A relevant Diploma qualification (or higher) and demonstrated experience within technology, engineering or a related technical discipline. Travel Domestic travel may be required to Brisbane, Sydney and Perth to support training activities and stakeholder engagement. Security Clearance Due to the security requirements associated with this position, applicants must be Australian Citizens and hold, or be eligible to obtain, a Baseline Security Clearance. Successful applicants will also be required to complete an Airservices Background Check and obtain and maintain an Aviation Security Identification Card (ASIC). Candidates who are immediately available or able to commence on, or close to, 12 October 2026 are strongly encouraged to apply. Please see the link below to view the full Position Description: For further information regarding this opportunity, please contact Sonya Suresha sonya.suresha@airservicesaustralia.com How To Apply To apply for this position please lodge an application online via the Apply link, attaching your resume and a cover letter outlining your skills and experience and how they relate to this role. Applications close: 11.59pm AEDT 24/09/26 Airservices values social and cultural diversity and is committed to the principles of equal employment opportunity and the provision of a safe and healthy work environment. In the interests of safety, we test for alcohol and other drugs. #AS2
